entities.name: P83299 carbonic anhydrase 1
observations: Reviewed Chionodraco hamatus carbonic anhydrase 1 is an exact 100% sequence match across 259 residues.
Catalyzes reversible hydration of carbon dioxide; zinc(II)-dependent, EC 4.2.1.1; annotated cytoplasmic.
Sequence-derived mass 28,342 Da and theoretical pI 5.58; Carb_anhydrase PF00194 detected at residues 11–258.

entities.name: RHEA:10748 carbon dioxide hydration
observations: Reversible reaction: hydrogencarbonate + H+ = CO2 + H2O; associated with carbonic anhydrase EC 4.2.1.1.
